programmes.name_en: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) income support for farmers
programmes.funder: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 every four months via DBT

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the PM-KISAN portal (Farmer Corner > New Farmer Registration) or via a CSC
Complete Aadhaar-based eKYC and land-record verification by the state
Instalments of ₹2,000 are credited to the Aadhaar-linked bank account

eligibility.income_note: All landholding farmer families eligible; institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees (except Group D/MTS), income-tax payers and professionals excluded

programmes.source_snippet: Eligible landholding farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000 each through Direct Benefit Transfer.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (rural housing grant)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas; ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/NE/LWE districts; released in instalments linked to construction stages, plus 90-95 days of MGNREGS wages

procedure_steps.detail: Beneficiaries are identified from SECC-2011 / Awaas+ survey lists and approved by the Gram Sabha
Gram Panchayat enters details in AwaasSoft with Aadhaar and bank seeding
Instalments are paid by DBT as construction stages are geo-tagged and verified

eligibility.income_note: Houseless households and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses as per SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and Awaas+ survey; income-tax payers, government employees and asset owners excluded

programmes.source_snippet: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plain) / ₹1.30 lakh (hilly areas) is provided to eligible rural households to construct a pucca house.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (urban housing assistance)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Central assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh per EWS house (BLC component); interest subsidy up to ₹1.8 lakh on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG under the Interest Subsidy Scheme

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online on the PMAY-U portal or at the municipal ward/CSC
ULB verifies eligibility, income and 'no pucca house' declaration
Assistance/interest subsidy is released through the state/PLI to the beneficiary or lender

documents_required.doc: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house

eligibility.income_note: EWS up to ₹3 lakh/year, LIG ₹3–6 lakh, MIG ₹6–9 lakh annual household income; family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India

programmes.source_snippet: PMAY-U 2.0 provides central assistance and home-loan interest subsidy to urban EWS/LIG/MIG families without a pucca house.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (deposit-free LPG connection for poor women)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Deposit-free LPG connection (cylinder, regulator, hose) with free first refill and stove under Ujjwala 2.0; ₹300 per cylinder refill subsidy (up to 12 refills/year) credited by DBT

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or at any Indane/Bharatgas/HP Gas distributor
Submit KYC form with Aadhaar and complete eKYC (OTP/biometric)
Oil company approves; distributor installs the connection and free stove

documents_required.doc: Aadhaar card of the adult woman applicant

eligibility.income_note: Adult woman from a poor household without an existing LPG connection (SECC-2011 listed, SC/ST, PMAY-G, Antyodaya and similar categories, or self-declared poor under Ujjwala 2.0)

programmes.source_snippet: PMUY provides a deposit-free LPG connection in the name of an adult woman of a poor household; Ujjwala consumers also get ₹300 per refill subsidy via DBT.

programmes.name_local: आयुष्मान भारत – प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (AB PM-JAY)
programmes.name_en: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (₹5 lakh family health cover)
programmes.funder: National Health Authority, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Cashless hospitalisation cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled public and private hospitals; no premium

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility at mera.pmjay.gov.in or helpline 14555 using mobile/ration card
Get the Ayushman card made free at an empanelled hospital Ayushman Mitra desk or CSC
Show the card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment

documents_required.doc: Aadhaar card or any government ID

eligibility.income_note: Families identified as deprived in SECC-2011 (rural deprivation criteria / urban informal occupations); since 2024 all citizens aged 70+ are covered irrespective of income

programmes.source_snippet: PM-JAY gives free health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation; expanded in 2024 to all citizens aged 70+.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (zero-balance bank account for every adult)
programmes.funder: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Zero-balance Basic Savings account with free RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance on the card, overdraft up to ₹10,000 after 6 months, and DBT receipt of all scheme payments

procedure_steps.detail: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent with Aadhaar/KYC documents
Fill the Financial Inclusion account-opening form
Receive passbook and RuPay debit card; link Aadhaar for DBT

eligibility.income_note: Any unbanked Indian adult; no income bar

programmes.source_snippet: PMJDY offers a zero-minimum-balance account with RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident cover and overdraft up to ₹10,000.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (collateral-free micro-business loans)
programmes.funder: MUDRA Ltd (SIDBI subsidiary) / Department of Financial Services
programmes.amount_note: Collateral-free loans: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore ₹50,001–5 lakh; Tarun ₹5–10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh (for borrowers who repaid a Tarun loan). This is a loan, not a grant.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at any bank, RRB, NBFC-MFI or via udyamimitra.in / Jan Samarth portal
Submit business plan/project report and KYC
Loan sanctioned without collateral under CGFMU guarantee

eligibility.income_note: Non-corporate, non-farm micro/small enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services; no loan-default history

programmes.source_snippet: PMMY gives collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh (Tarun Plus) to non-farm micro and small enterprises through banks and NBFCs.

programmes.name_en: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (micro-credit for street vendors)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (implemented by SIDBI)
programmes.amount_note: Working-capital loan of ₹10,000, then ₹20,000, then ₹50,000 in successive cycles on repayment; 7% annual interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or at a CSC/ULB help desk
ULB verifies Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation
Loan disbursed by lending bank; interest subsidy credited quarterly

documents_required.doc: Certificate of Vending / Identity Card or LoR from ULB

eligibility.income_note: Street vendors vending on or before 24 March 2020 and identified in the ULB survey (or with LoR)

programmes.source_snippet: PM SVANidhi provides collateral-free working-capital loans of ₹10,000–₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy to urban street vendors.

programmes.name_en: Stand-Up India (bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs)
programmes.funder: Department of Financial Services / SIDBI (Stand-Up Mitra portal)
programmes.amount_note: Composite bank loan (incl. working capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for a greenfield enterprise. Loan, not a grant.

procedure_steps.detail: Register and apply on standupmitra.in or directly at a bank branch
Prepare project report; connect with handholding agencies if needed
Bank appraises and sanctions the composite loan

eligibility.income_note: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied enterprise

programmes.source_snippet: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises.

programmes.name_en: PM Vishwakarma (support for traditional artisans and craftspeople)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Recognition + skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹1 lakh then ₹2 lakh at 5% concessional interest

procedure_steps.detail: Register at a CSC or on pmvishwakarma.gov.in with Aadhaar-based biometric verification
Verification by Gram Panchayat/ULB and district committee
Receive certificate/ID, training, toolkit incentive and apply for the concessional loan

eligibility.income_note: Artisans/craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 listed trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, barber, cobbler etc.) in the unorganised sector

programmes.source_snippet: PM Vishwakarma gives artisans training stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit support and loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.

programmes.name_en: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (margin-money subsidy for new micro-units)
programmes.funder: Ministry of MSME / Khadi and Village Industries Commission
programmes.amount_note: Margin-money subsidy of 15–35% of project cost (higher for SC/ST/OBC/women/minorities/NER and rural units); max project cost ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (services). Subsidy is locked against the bank loan, not free cash.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online on the KVIC PMEGP e-portal
District task force interview and project approval
Bank sanctions loan; subsidy released to a locked deposit against the loan

eligibility.income_note: Any individual (VIII pass for projects above ₹10 lakh manufacturing/₹5 lakh services) setting up a NEW micro-enterprise; no income ceiling

programmes.source_snippet: PMEGP gives 15–35% margin-money subsidy on bank loans for setting up new manufacturing/service micro-enterprises.

programmes.name_en: Atal Pension Yojana (guaranteed pension for unorganised workers)
programmes.funder: PFRDA / Department of Financial Services, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 per month from age 60, depending on the contribution chosen; spouse pension and nominee corpus on death

procedure_steps.detail: Fill the APY form at your bank branch (or via netbanking where offered)
Choose pension slab; monthly/quarterly auto-debit contribution starts
Pension begins at age 60

eligibility.income_note: Open to all citizens aged 18–40 with a savings account; income-tax payers (as on/after 1 Oct 2022) are not eligible to join

programmes.source_snippet: APY guarantees a ₹1,000–₹5,000 monthly pension after 60 against modest contributions from age 18–40.

programmes.name_en: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (₹2 lakh life insurance at ₹436/year)
programmes.funder: Department of Financial Services (through LIC/banks)
programmes.amount_note: ₹2 lakh life cover on death from any cause for an annual premium of ₹436 auto-debited from the bank account
programmes.deadline_note: Renewal premium auto-debited each year before 31 May

procedure_steps.detail: Give consent for auto-debit at your bank branch or via netbanking
Premium of ₹436 is debited annually
Nominee claims ₹2 lakh on the insured's death

eligibility.income_note: Any savings-account holder aged 18–50 who consents to auto-debit; cover continues up to age 55

programmes.source_snippet: PMJJBY offers ₹2 lakh term life cover at ₹436 per year for bank account holders aged 18–50.

programmes.name_en: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (₹2 lakh accident insurance at ₹20/year)
programmes.funder: Department of Financial Services (through general insurers/banks)
programmes.amount_note: ₹2 lakh for accidental death/full disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability for an annual premium of ₹20 auto-debited from the bank account
programmes.deadline_note: Renewal premium auto-debited each year before 31 May

procedure_steps.detail: Give auto-debit consent at your bank branch or via netbanking
Premium of ₹20 debited annually
Claim on accidental death or disability

eligibility.income_note: Any savings-account holder aged 18–70 who consents to auto-debit

programmes.source_snippet: PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability cover at ₹20 per year for bank account holders aged 18–70.

programmes.name_en: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (high-interest savings for the girl child)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Finance / National Savings Institute (post offices & banks)
programmes.amount_note: Government-guaranteed interest (8.2% p.a. for Q1 FY2026-27, revised quarterly) on deposits of ₹250–₹1.5 lakh/year for 15 years; EEE tax treatment; matures 21 years after opening

procedure_steps.detail: Open an SSY account at any post office or authorised bank in the girl's name
Deposit ₹250–₹1.5 lakh each financial year for 15 years
Maturity after 21 years; 50% partial withdrawal allowed for education after 18

eligibility.income_note: For a girl child below 10 at account opening; maximum two accounts per family (exception for twins/triplets); no income bar

programmes.source_snippet: SSY is a small-savings scheme for girls under 10: ₹250–₹1.5 lakh/year deposits earn a government-notified rate (currently 8.2%) with full tax exemption.

programmes.name_local: अनुसूचित जाति के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
programmes.name_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC students (National Scholarship Portal)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Covers tuition/compulsory fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance (day-scholar and hosteller rates notified annually); paid by DBT
programmes.deadline_note: NSP application window usually opens around July–October each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Register and apply on the National Scholarship Portal
Institute, district and state verify the application
Scholarship credited by DBT through PFMS

eligibility.income_note: Scheduled Caste students; family annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh

programmes.source_snippet: Centrally sponsored post-matric scholarship pays fees plus maintenance allowance to SC students with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year.

programmes.name_local: अनुसूचित जनजाति के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
programmes.name_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST students (National Scholarship Portal)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Tuition/compulsory fees plus monthly maintenance allowance for ST students studying after Class 10; DBT to the student's account
programmes.deadline_note: NSP application window usually opens around July–October each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Register and apply on the National Scholarship Portal
Institute/district/state verification
DBT disbursement through PFMS

eligibility.income_note: Scheduled Tribe students; family annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh

programmes.source_snippet: Post-matric scholarship for ST students covers fees and a maintenance allowance where family income is up to ₹2.5 lakh a year.

programmes.name_en: PM-YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT students
programmes.funder: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Tuition fees plus monthly academic allowance under the PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India (PM-YASASVI)
programmes.deadline_note: NSP application window usually opens around July–October each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal under the PM-YASASVI scheme
Institute and state verification
DBT to student bank account

eligibility.income_note: OBC, EBC and De-notified Tribe students; family annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh (per current guidelines/state notice)

programmes.source_snippet: PM-YASASVI post-matric scholarship supports OBC/EBC/DNT students with fees and allowance where family income is up to ₹2.5 lakh.

programmes.name_en: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for minority community students
programmes.funder: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 per year plus maintenance allowance for professional/technical courses
programmes.deadline_note: NSP application window usually opens around July–October each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal
Institute/state verification
DBT disbursement

eligibility.income_note: Students from six notified minority communities with at least 50% marks and family income up to ₹2.5 lakh/year, admitted to technical/professional courses

programmes.source_snippet: Merit-cum-Means scholarship reimburses course fees up to ₹20,000 a year plus maintenance for minority students in professional courses.

programmes.name_en: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for wards of CAPF/Assam Rifles and police personnel
programmes.funder: Ministry of Home Affairs (via National Scholarship Portal)
programmes.amount_note: Fixed monthly scholarship for the duration of the first professional degree course (rates for boys and girls notified by MHA; enhanced from ₹2,500/₹3,000 in recent years)
programmes.deadline_note: NSP window each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on NSP under PM Scholarship Scheme
Verification by CAPF/police authority and institute
DBT to student account; renewal on passing each year

documents_required.doc: Service certificate of parent (CAPF/Assam Rifles/State Police)

eligibility.income_note: Dependent wards/widows of CAPF, Assam Rifles and state police personnel (incl. martyred/disabled); minimum 60% in Class 12; first professional degree

programmes.source_snippet: PMSS pays a monthly scholarship to wards and widows of CAPF, Assam Rifles and police personnel pursuing first professional degrees.

programmes.name_en: PM Internship Scheme (12-month paid internship in top companies)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: ₹5,000/month stipend (₹4,500 from government via DBT + ₹500 from the company) for 12 months plus a one-time ₹6,000 joining grant
programmes.deadline_note: Applications open in rounds announced on the portal

procedure_steps.detail: Register free on pminternship.mca.gov.in with Aadhaar and education details
Apply to up to five internship postings matching location/sector/qualification
Company shortlists and offers; stipend paid monthly by DBT

eligibility.income_note: Family income under ₹8 lakh/year; no family member a permanent government employee; candidate not in full-time employment or full-time education

programmes.source_snippet: PM Internship Scheme pays ₹5,000 a month plus a ₹6,000 grant for a 12-month internship at 500+ top companies for youth aged 21–24 with family income under ₹8 lakh.

programmes.name_local: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA)
programmes.name_en: MGNREGA – 100 days guaranteed rural wage employment
programmes.funder: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: State-notified daily wage (roughly ₹240–₹400 depending on state, revised every April) for up to 100 days of unskilled manual work per rural household per year; wages via DBT within 15 days

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for a free job card at your Gram Panchayat (or via UMANG app)
Demand work in writing; work must be offered within 15 days else unemployment allowance
Wages credited to Aadhaar-linked bank/post-office account

documents_required.doc: Job card (issued free by Gram Panchayat)

eligibility.income_note: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work; no income bar or BPL requirement

programmes.source_snippet: MGNREGA legally guarantees 100 days of paid unskilled work per rural household per year at state-notified wage rates.

programmes.name_local: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम / पीएम गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना
programmes.name_en: NFSA / PMGKAY free food grains through ration shops
programmes.funder: Department of Food & Public Distribution, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: 5 kg free food grains per person per month for priority households and 35 kg per month per Antyodaya (AAY) family; free-of-cost distribution extended under PMGKAY

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain a ration card from the state food department if not already held
Complete Aadhaar seeding and e-KYC of family members
Collect monthly free grains at the fair price shop using biometric authentication

eligibility.income_note: Priority and Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration-card households identified by states under NFSA coverage (about 80 crore persons)

programmes.source_snippet: NFSA/PMGKAY provides 5 kg of free food grains per person per month to priority ration-card households and 35 kg to AAY families.

programmes.name_en: Annapurna Scheme (10 kg free food grains for destitute seniors)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
programmes.amount_note: 10 kg of free food grains per month to eligible destitute elderly persons who are not receiving a pension under IGNOAPS

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the Gram Panchayat/Block office or municipality
Verification of age and non-receipt of pension
Monthly grain allocation through the ration shop

eligibility.income_note: Destitute elderly (65+) eligible for IGNOAPS but not currently receiving that pension

programmes.source_snippet: Annapurna gives 10 kg of free food grains monthly to destitute senior citizens who are not covered by the old-age pension.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Matru Vandana Yojana (maternity benefit of ₹5,000)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: ₹5,000 in instalments for the first living child (₹1,000 registration + ₹2,000 after 6 months of pregnancy + ₹2,000 after birth/immunisation); additional ₹6,000 for a second child if a girl

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the Anganwadi/health facility or on the PMMVY portal
Submit MCP card and Aadhaar-linked bank details
Instalments credited by DBT after each milestone is verified

documents_required.doc: Child birth certificate and immunisation proof (later instalments)

eligibility.income_note: Pregnant/lactating women (19+) for first living child, excluding those in government/PSU employment or receiving similar benefits; second girl child also covered under Mission Shakti expansion

programmes.source_snippet: PMMVY provides ₹5,000 maternity benefit in instalments for the first child and ₹6,000 for a second girl child via DBT.

programmes.name_en: Janani Suraksha Yojana (cash incentive for institutional delivery)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (National Health Mission)
programmes.amount_note: Cash assistance for institutional delivery: ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) in low-performing states, ₹700/₹600 in other states; ASHA incentive additional

procedure_steps.detail: Register pregnancy at the nearest government health facility/ASHA worker
Deliver at a government or accredited private health institution
Cash incentive paid at the facility or into the bank account

eligibility.income_note: Pregnant women delivering at health institutions; in low-performing states all women, elsewhere BPL/SC-ST women (19+)

programmes.source_snippet: JSY gives a cash incentive to pregnant women for delivering in a health institution to reduce maternal and infant mortality.

programmes.name_local: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना (IGNOAPS)
programmes.name_en: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
programmes.funder: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP), with state top-ups
programmes.amount_note: Central share ₹200/month for ages 60–79 and ₹500/month for 80+; almost all states add a top-up, so actual monthly pension ranges roughly ₹400–₹3,000 by state

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Gram Panchayat/Block office, municipality or state social welfare portal
Verification of age and BPL status
Pension credited monthly by DBT

eligibility.income_note: Persons aged 60+ belonging to households below the poverty line

programmes.source_snippet: IGNOAPS pays ₹200–₹500 a month (centre's share; states top up) to BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above.

programmes.name_local: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना (IGNWPS)
programmes.name_en: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
programmes.funder: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP), with state top-ups
programmes.amount_note: Central share ₹300/month (₹500 for 80+); states add top-ups, so actual pension varies by state

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Gram Panchayat/Block/municipal office or state welfare portal
Verification of widowhood, age and BPL status
Monthly DBT pension

eligibility.income_note: BPL widows aged 40–79 (80+ shift to IGNOAPS at ₹500)

programmes.source_snippet: IGNWPS pays ₹300 a month (centre's share) to BPL widows aged 40–79, with state top-ups.

programmes.name_local: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना (IGNDPS)
programmes.name_en: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
programmes.funder: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP), with state top-ups
programmes.amount_note: Central share ₹300/month (₹500 for 80+) for persons with severe or multiple disabilities; state top-ups apply

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Gram Panchayat/Block/municipal office or state welfare portal
Disability and BPL verification
Monthly DBT pension

eligibility.income_note: BPL persons aged 18–79 with severe or multiple disabilities

programmes.source_snippet: IGNDPS pays ₹300 a month (centre's share) to BPL persons with severe or multiple disabilities aged 18–79.

programmes.name_en: e-Shram – national database and social security for unorganised workers
programmes.funder: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Free registration with Universal Account Number; registered workers get accidental insurance cover of ₹2 lakh (death/total disability; ₹1 lakh partial) under PMSBY-linked cover, and a single gateway to welfare schemes

procedure_steps.detail: Self-register free on eshram.gov.in or at a CSC using Aadhaar
Enter occupation, bank and nominee details; e-Shram card with UAN issued
Accident insurance cover attaches automatically; use UAN to access linked schemes

eligibility.income_note: Any unorganised/informal worker (construction, domestic, street vendor, gig, agricultural labour etc.) not in EPFO/ESIC/NPS-Govt coverage

programmes.source_snippet: e-Shram registers unorganised workers free and provides ₹2 lakh accidental insurance plus access to central social-security schemes.

programmes.name_en: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (₹3,000 monthly pension for unorganised workers)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Labour and Employment / LIC
programmes.amount_note: Assured pension of ₹3,000/month from age 60 with 50% matching government contribution; monthly subscriber contribution ₹55–₹200 depending on entry age

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol free at a CSC (or self-register on maandhan.in) with Aadhaar
Monthly contribution auto-debited until age 60
Pension of ₹3,000/month starts at 60; spouse pension on death

documents_required.doc: Savings/Jan Dhan bank account with IFSC

eligibility.income_note: Unorganised workers with monthly income up to ₹15,000, not covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS and not income-tax payers

programmes.source_snippet: PM-SYM gives unorganised workers earning up to ₹15,000/month an assured ₹3,000 monthly pension after 60 with equal government contribution.

programmes.name_local: पीएम पोषण शक्ति निर्माण (PM POSHAN / मिड-डे मील)
programmes.name_en: PM POSHAN (free hot cooked mid-day meal in schools)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Education, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: One free hot cooked meal (approx. 450 calories primary / 700 calories upper-primary norms) on every school day to children in Balvatika to Class VIII in government and government-aided schools

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol the child in a government or government-aided school
Meal is served automatically on all school days — no application needed

documents_required.note: No separate application; benefit is automatic on enrolment

eligibility.income_note: All children in Balvatika to Class VIII of government/government-aided schools, local-body and madrasa institutions; no income test

programmes.source_snippet: PM POSHAN serves a free hot cooked meal on every school day to children up to Class VIII in government and aided schools.

programmes.name_local: एससी और ओबीसी छात्रों के लिए मुफ्त कोचिंग योजना
programmes.name_en: Scheme of Free Coaching for SC and OBC students
programmes.funder: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Free coaching for competitive exams (UPSC, SSC, banking, NEET/JEE etc.) in empanelled institutions plus a monthly stipend (₹3,000 local / ₹6,000 outstation) during the course
programmes.deadline_note: Applications invited through portal notices/ads; selection on merit-cum-means

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online at coaching.dosje.gov.in when the window opens
Selection by merit within income-eligible SC/OBC candidates
Join allotted empanelled coaching institute; stipend via DBT

eligibility.income_note: SC and OBC students with family income up to ₹8 lakh/year; preference to candidates who have not availed the scheme before

programmes.source_snippet: The scheme funds free coaching in empanelled institutes plus a monthly stipend for SC/OBC students with family income up to ₹8 lakh.

programmes.name_en: PM eVIDYA / DIKSHA (free digital learning content)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Education / NCERT, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Free access to digital textbooks, e-content, TV/radio classes and QR-coded Energized Textbooks on the DIKSHA platform for all classes and boards

procedure_steps.detail: Open diksha.gov.in or the DIKSHA app, or scan QR codes in NCERT textbooks
Choose board, medium and class to access free e-content

documents_required.note: Open access platform; no documents required

eligibility.income_note: Open to all students, teachers and parents free of cost

programmes.source_snippet: DIKSHA under PM eVIDYA gives every student free digital textbooks and curriculum-linked e-content.

programmes.name_local: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
programmes.name_en: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (rooftop solar subsidy)
programmes.funder: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Central subsidy ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW and ₹78,000 for 3 kW or more (capped) residential rooftop solar, credited to the consumer's bank account after commissioning

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the national rooftop solar portal with DISCOM and consumer number
Get DISCOM feasibility approval and install via an empanelled vendor
After inspection and net-metering, subsidy is transferred within ~30 days

eligibility.income_note: Any residential consumer with a suitable roof and an on-grid system up to 10 kW; no income test; collateral-free loans up to ₹2 lakh at subsidised rates also offered

programmes.source_snippet: PM Surya Ghar gives up to ₹78,000 subsidy for residential rooftop solar, targeting 300 units of free electricity a month for 1 crore households.

programmes.name_en: PM-KUSUM (solar pumps and plants for farmers)
programmes.funder: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Component B: 30% central subsidy plus 30% state support for standalone solar agriculture pumps (farmer share ~40%); Component C: 30% subsidy for solarisation of grid-connected pumps
programmes.deadline_note: State-wise allocations and tenders announced periodically

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the PM-KUSUM/state renewable agency portal when allocations open
Deposit farmer share after approval
Installation by empanelled vendor; subsidy released to vendor

eligibility.income_note: Farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, FPOs and water-user associations with cultivable land and water source

programmes.source_snippet: PM-KUSUM subsidises solar agriculture pumps and pump solarisation with about 60% central-plus-state support.

programmes.name_en: Kisan Credit Card (concessional crop and allied-activity credit)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Finance / all scheduled banks and cooperatives
programmes.amount_note: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest, effectively 4% with the 3% prompt-repayment incentive under interest subvention; higher limits for animal husbandry/fisheries (₹2 lakh window)

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at your bank branch with land records (or via PM-KISAN KCC drive)
Bank fixes credit limit based on cropping pattern and scale of finance
Withdraw as needed; interest subvention applied on timely repayment

documents_required.doc: Fisheries/animal husbandry activity proof (for allied window)

eligibility.income_note: All farmers (owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees), SHGs/JLGs of farmers, and animal husbandry/fisheries workers

programmes.source_snippet: KCC provides revolving crop credit at 7% (effectively 4% on prompt repayment) for limits up to ₹3 lakh.

programmes.name_en: Modified Interest Subvention Scheme for short-term crop loans
programmes.funder: Ministry of Agriculture / RBI-implemented through banks
programmes.amount_note: Interest subvention of 1.5% to lending institutions plus 3% prompt-repayment incentive, making short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh available at an effective 4% per annum
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically through KCC/crop loans each year

procedure_steps.detail: Take a KCC/short-term crop loan from a bank
Repay on time; the 3% prompt-repayment incentive reduces the effective rate to 4% automatically

documents_required.doc: Kisan Credit Card / crop loan account

eligibility.income_note: Farmers availing short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh (₹2 lakh sub-limit for animal husbandry and fisheries)

programmes.source_snippet: The interest subvention scheme delivers short-term crop loans at an effective 4% to farmers who repay promptly.

programmes.name_en: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Yield-based crop insurance: farmer pays only 2% of sum insured (kharif), 1.5% (rabi) and 5% (horticulture/commercial crops); balance premium shared by centre and states; claims paid by DBT
programmes.deadline_note: Enrolment deadlines are notified each season (sowing cut-off dates)

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol on pmfby.gov.in (Farmer Corner), at a bank, CSC or through the loaning bank
Pay the subsidised farmer premium share
Report crop loss within 72 hours; claims settled to bank account

eligibility.income_note: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers (enrolment voluntary for non-loanee farmers)

programmes.source_snippet: PMFBY insures crops against natural risks at subsidised farmer premiums of 1.5–5% of the sum insured.

programmes.name_en: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
programmes.funder: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
programmes.amount_note: Up to ₹20 lakh as grants for prototype/trials and up to ₹50 lakh as investment (convertible debentures/debt) through approved incubators
programmes.deadline_note: Incubator-wise application windows announced on the portal

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the Startup India Seed Fund portal to selected incubators
Incubator's selection committee evaluates and recommends funding
Milestone-based disbursement

eligibility.income_note: DPIIT-recognised startups incorporated not more than 2 years earlier, at idea/prototype stage, not having raised more than ₹10 lakh earlier

programmes.source_snippet: SISFS provides up to ₹20 lakh in grants and ₹50 lakh in investment to early-stage DPIIT-recognised startups via incubators.

programmes.name_en: Central Sector Interest Subsidy on education loans (CSIS)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Education (through Canara Bank as nodal bank)
programmes.amount_note: Full interest subsidy during the moratorium (course period + one year) on education loans up to ₹7.5 lakh for students from economically weaker sections; see also PM Vidyalaxmi for wider coverage

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for an education loan through the Vidya Lakshmi portal to a scheduled bank
Submit EWS income proof; bank claims the interest subsidy
No interest payable during the moratorium period

eligibility.income_note: Students from families with annual income up to ₹4.5 lakh pursuing technical/professional courses in India

programmes.source_snippet: CSIS waives the interest during study and moratorium on education loans up to ₹7.5 lakh for students with family income up to ₹4.5 lakh.

programmes.name_en: LPG refill subsidy via PAHAL (DBTL) direct transfer
programmes.funder: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / OMCs (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy on domestic LPG refills credited directly to the consumer's Aadhaar-linked bank account; currently ₹300 per cylinder (up to 12 refills/year) targeted at PMUY consumers; general-DBT subsidy varies with government notifications

procedure_steps.detail: Link Aadhaar with your LPG ID and bank account at the distributor or mylpg.in
Book refills as usual; subsidy is credited automatically after delivery

eligibility.income_note: Domestic LPG consumers with Aadhaar-seeded connection and bank account; ₹300/cylinder targeted subsidy is for PMUY beneficiaries

programmes.source_snippet: PAHAL/DBTL credits the LPG refill subsidy directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank account; PMUY consumers get ₹300 per cylinder.

programmes.name_en: Indian Railways fare concessions (disabled, students, patients)
programmes.funder: Indian Railways (Ministry of Railways)
programmes.amount_note: Fare concessions of 25–75% by category: persons with disabilities (up to 75% in most classes), certain patients (cancer, TB etc.), war widows and students on authorised journeys (50% in second/sleeper); the general senior-citizen concession remains suspended since March 2020

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain the relevant concession certificate (disability/medical/institution)
Book tickets at the counter/PRS showing the certificate, or upload details as required
Concession applied to eligible class and category

eligibility.income_note: Category-based: persons with disabilities, specified patients, students on permitted journeys and gallantry-award/war-widow categories; general senior-citizen concession currently suspended

programmes.source_snippet: Indian Railways grants 25–75% fare concessions to persons with disabilities, certain patients and students on authorised journeys.

programmes.name_en: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi (free electricity up to 200 units)
programmes.funder: Department of Energy, Government of Karnataka
programmes.amount_note: Zero electricity bill for monthly consumption within the household's free-unit entitlement (average FY2022-23 usage + 10%, capped at 200 units); full bill payable if usage exceeds 200 units

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Seva Sindhu portal (or at Grama One/Karnataka One/Bangalore One)
Enter ESCOM, connection ID and Aadhaar details
Free units applied automatically on the monthly bill

eligibility.income_note: All domestic residential connections in Karnataka (owners and tenants) whose FY2022-23 average monthly consumption is up to 200 units

programmes.source_snippet: Gruha Jyothi gives Karnataka households free electricity up to 200 units a month, merged from the earlier Bhagya Jyothi/Kuteera Jyothi schemes.

programmes.name_en: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi (₹2,000/month to women heads of household)
programmes.funder: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
programmes.amount_note: ₹2,000 per month by DBT to the woman head of the family listed on the ration card

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on Seva Sindhu or at Grama One/Karnataka One centres
Ration card head-of-family verification and Aadhaar-bank seeding
₹2,000 credited monthly by DBT

documents_required.doc: Ration card (applicant as head of family)

eligibility.income_note: Woman head of a BPL/APL ration-card household in Karnataka; families of government employees and income-tax payers excluded

programmes.source_snippet: Gruha Lakshmi pays ₹2,000 a month to women heads of ration-card households in Karnataka.

programmes.name_en: Karnataka Anna Bhagya (free rice plus cash top-up)
programmes.funder: Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of Karnataka
programmes.amount_note: 10 kg of rice per person per month for BPL/AAY cardholders — 5 kg free from the centre plus state top-up given partly as DBT cash (₹170 per person per month in lieu of the additional 5 kg in recent implementation)

procedure_steps.detail: Hold a BPL/priority ration card with Aadhaar seeding
Collect 5 kg free rice at the fair price shop; top-up cash credited by DBT

eligibility.income_note: BPL and Antyodaya ration-card households in Karnataka

programmes.source_snippet: Anna Bhagya gives BPL households 10 kg of rice per person per month, with the state share partly paid as DBT cash.

programmes.name_en: Karnataka Shakti (free bus travel for women)
programmes.funder: Department of Transport, Government of Karnataka
programmes.amount_note: Free travel for women on non-premium (ordinary, city, express) buses of KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC and KKRTC within Karnataka; 50% of seats reserved for men

procedure_steps.detail: Travel free by showing an accepted ID, or apply for the Shakti smart card on Seva Sindhu
Smart card dispatched to registered address after verification

eligibility.income_note: Women and transgender persons domiciled in Karnataka; valid only on ordinary/express buses within the state

programmes.source_snippet: Shakti allows women domiciled in Karnataka to travel free on non-premium state transport buses within the state.

programmes.name_en: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi (unemployment allowance for youth)
programmes.funder: Department of Skill Development, Government of Karnataka
programmes.amount_note: ₹3,000/month for unemployed graduates and ₹1,500/month for diploma holders, for up to 2 years after passing

procedure_steps.detail: Register on Seva Sindhu within the eligibility window after passing
Education and unemployment verification
Monthly DBT until employment or 2-year cap

eligibility.income_note: Unemployed graduates/diploma holders (2022-23 pass-outs onwards) domiciled in Karnataka, not in jobs, higher studies or covered by ESI/PF

programmes.source_snippet: Yuva Nidhi pays ₹1,500–₹3,000 a month to unemployed diploma holders and graduates in Karnataka for up to two years.

programmes.name_en: Delhi free electricity (zero bill up to 200 units)
programmes.funder: Government of NCT of Delhi (through BSES/TPDDL discoms)
programmes.amount_note: Entire bill waived to ₹0 for consumption up to 200 units/month; 50% subsidy (capped at ₹800/month) for 201–400 units; no subsidy above 400 units
programmes.deadline_note: Opt-in confirmation may be requested by the discom each year

procedure_steps.detail: Subsidy applies automatically to domestic bills; opt in via discom app/missed call if asked
Keep monthly consumption within 200 units for a zero bill

documents_required.note: Bill in resident's or family member's name

eligibility.income_note: All domestic consumers of BSES Rajdhani, BSES Yamuna and Tata Power-DDL; one subsidised connection per household

programmes.source_snippet: Delhi households pay ₹0 for up to 200 units a month and half price for 201–400 units (capped), funded by the Delhi government.

programmes.name_en: Delhi free water up to 20 kilolitres per month
programmes.funder: Delhi Jal Board, Government of NCT of Delhi
programmes.amount_note: Zero water bill for domestic consumers with functional meters using up to 20 kilolitres per month; full bill payable if consumption exceeds 20 kL

procedure_steps.detail: Hold a domestic DJB connection with a working meter
Zero bill is generated automatically when monthly consumption is within 20 kL

eligibility.income_note: Domestic metered water consumers in Delhi using up to 20 kL/month

programmes.source_snippet: DJB domestic consumers using up to 20 kilolitres a month get a zero water bill.

programmes.name_local: दिल्ली महिला मुफ्त बस यात्रा (पिंक टिकट)
programmes.name_en: Delhi free bus travel for women (pink ticket)
programmes.funder: Department of Transport, Government of NCT of Delhi
programmes.amount_note: Free travel for women and girls on all DTC and cluster (orange) buses within Delhi using the free pink single-journey ticket issued by the conductor

procedure_steps.detail: Board any DTC or cluster bus and take a free pink ticket from the conductor
No pass, card or application needed

documents_required.note: Open to all women and girls

eligibility.income_note: All women and girls travelling within Delhi on DTC/cluster buses

programmes.source_snippet: Women travel free on DTC and cluster buses in Delhi with a pink ticket issued on board.

programmes.name_en: Delhi Ladli Scheme (staged deposits for the girl child)
programmes.funder: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of NCT of Delhi
programmes.amount_note: Staged deposits (₹11,000 at institutional birth/₹10,000 at home birth, then ₹5,000 each at admission to Classes I, VI, IX and XII) maturing with interest when the girl turns 18 and passes Class X/XII

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the district WCD office/anganwadi or through the school
Deposits made with SBI Life at each education milestone
Maturity amount paid to the girl at 18 on meeting conditions

eligibility.income_note: Girls born in Delhi whose family has lived in Delhi for 3+ years with annual income up to ₹1 lakh; maximum two girls per family

programmes.source_snippet: Ladli builds a maturity fund for Delhi girls from low-income families through staged deposits linked to schooling.

programmes.name_en: Delhi doorstep delivery of ration (Mukhya Mantri Ghar Ghar Ration Yojana)
programmes.funder: Department of Food, Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of NCT of Delhi
programmes.amount_note: Home delivery of the NFSA entitlement of packaged wheat flour/rice to ration-card households instead of collection at the fair price shop; rollout status depends on current government orders

procedure_steps.detail: Hold a Delhi NFSA ration card with Aadhaar seeding
Opt in for doorstep delivery when the window/service is active

eligibility.income_note: Delhi NFSA ration-card households (priority and AAY)

programmes.source_snippet: The scheme delivers NFSA rations to the homes of Delhi cardholders; availability depends on the current rollout.

programmes.name_en: Tamil Nadu free bus travel for women (Vidiyal Payanam)
programmes.funder: Department of Transport, Government of Tamil Nadu
programmes.amount_note: Free travel for women and transgender persons on ordinary-fare city and mofussil buses of state transport corporations within Tamil Nadu using a zero-fare ticket

procedure_steps.detail: Board an ordinary-fare state transport bus and take the free zero-value ticket
No application needed; premium/AC services excluded

documents_required.note: Open to women and transgender passengers

eligibility.income_note: Women and transgender persons travelling on ordinary-fare government buses within Tamil Nadu

programmes.source_snippet: Vidiyal Payanam lets women and transgender persons ride ordinary state buses in Tamil Nadu free of charge.

programmes.name_en: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme
programmes.funder: School Education Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
programmes.amount_note: Free breakfast on all school days for students of Classes 1–5 in government and government-aided primary schools (statewide since August 2023), in addition to the mid-day meal

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol the child in a government/government-aided primary school
Breakfast is served automatically on school days

eligibility.income_note: All students of Classes 1–5 in Tamil Nadu government and aided primary schools

programmes.source_snippet: The Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme serves a free breakfast every school day to primary students across Tamil Nadu.

programmes.name_en: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (₹1,000/month to women heads of family)
programmes.funder: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
programmes.amount_note: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000/year) by DBT to eligible women heads of families

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the e-Sevai centre/ration shop during enrolment drives or on kmut.tn.gov.in
Ration-card head-of-family and eligibility verification
₹1,000 credited monthly by DBT

documents_required.doc: Smart ration card (woman as head of family)

eligibility.income_note: Woman head of a ration-card family; family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year, land under 5 acres wetland/10 acres dryland, annual electricity use under 3,600 units

programmes.source_snippet: KMUT pays ₹1,000 a month to over 1.3 crore eligible women heads of families in Tamil Nadu.

programmes.name_en: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn (₹1,000/month for college-going girls from government schools)
programmes.funder: Higher Education Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
programmes.amount_note: ₹1,000 per month by DBT to girls who studied Classes 6–12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and are now enrolled in recognised UG/diploma/ITI courses
programmes.deadline_note: Apply through the college during enrolment each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Apply through the college nodal officer with EMIS/records
Verification of government-school study (6th–12th) and current enrolment
₹1,000 credited monthly for the course duration

eligibility.income_note: Girl students who completed Classes 6–12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and joined higher education; Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar scheme

programmes.source_snippet: Pudhumai Penn pays ₹1,000 a month to girls from government schools pursuing college education in Tamil Nadu.

programmes.name_en: Maharashtra Mukhyamantri Mazi Ladki Bahin Yojana (₹1,500/month)
programmes.funder: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Maharashtra
programmes.amount_note: ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000/year) by DBT to eligible women; over 2.35 crore women enrolled

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in or the app, or at a Setu/Anganwadi centre
Domicile, age, income and Aadhaar-bank verification
₹1,500 credited monthly by DBT

eligibility.income_note: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or unmarried women (21–65) domiciled in Maharashtra with family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year; taxpayers and government employees excluded

programmes.source_snippet: Ladki Bahin pays ₹1,500 a month to eligible women aged 21–65 in Maharashtra with family income under ₹2.5 lakh.

programmes.name_en: Telangana Rythu Bandhu (₹5,000 per acre per season investment support)
programmes.funder: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
programmes.amount_note: ₹5,000 per acre per season (₹10,000 per acre per year, kharif + rabi) paid by DBT/cheque to landholding farmers; total depends on landholding
programmes.deadline_note: Disbursed before each kharif and rabi season

procedure_steps.detail: Land records updated in the Dharani portal / Pattadar passbook
Village-level verification by agriculture officers
Amount credited each season based on acreage

eligibility.income_note: Farmers owning agricultural land in Telangana (Pattadars); income-tax payers and public representatives excluded

programmes.source_snippet: Rythu Bandhu gives Telangana landholding farmers ₹5,000 per acre per season as agriculture investment support.

programmes.name_en: Telangana Mahalakshmi Scheme (₹2,500/month to eligible women)
programmes.funder: Government of Telangana (Praja Palana / SERP)
programmes.amount_note: ₹2,500 per month to eligible women heads of low-income households identified through Praja Palana applications
programmes.deadline_note: Enrolment via Praja Palana application drives announced by the state

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the Praja Palana application at the village/ward level
Field verification of household eligibility
₹2,500 monthly DBT to the woman's account

eligibility.income_note: Women heads of low-income households in Telangana (per Praja Palana criteria; white ration-card-type categories)

programmes.source_snippet: Mahalakshmi pays ₹2,500 a month to eligible women heads of households in Telangana.

programmes.name_en: West Bengal Lakshmir Bhandar (monthly allowance to women)
programmes.funder: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
programmes.amount_note: ₹1,500/month for general-category women and ₹1,700/month for SC/ST women (raised from ₹1,000/₹1,200 by the February 2026 interim budget); paid by DBT
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at Duare Sarkar camps or block/municipality offices

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at a Duare Sarkar camp / BDO / municipality with documents
Verification and sanction by the district administration
Monthly DBT to the woman's Aadhaar-linked account

eligibility.income_note: Women residents of West Bengal aged 25–60; families paying income tax or holding more than 2 hectares of land excluded

programmes.source_snippet: Lakshmir Bhandar pays a monthly allowance (₹1,500 general / ₹1,700 SC-ST after the 2026 hike) to over 2.2 crore women in West Bengal.

programmes.name_en: West Bengal Kanyashree Prakalpa (scholarships to keep girls in school)
programmes.funder: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
programmes.amount_note: K1: ₹1,000 annual scholarship for unmarried girls aged 13–18 in Class VIII or above; K2: ₹25,000 one-time grant at 18 if unmarried and continuing education/vocational training
programmes.deadline_note: Forms submitted through the school/college each academic year

procedure_steps.detail: Collect the K1/K2 form free from the school/college
Institution verifies and uploads to the Kanyashree portal; Kanyashree ID issued
Amount credited by DBT to the girl's bank account

eligibility.income_note: Unmarried girls of West Bengal; family income up to ₹1.2 lakh/year (waived for girls with disabilities, orphans and JJ-home residents)

programmes.source_snippet: Kanyashree gives unmarried school-going girls ₹1,000 a year (K1) and a ₹25,000 one-time grant at 18 (K2) via DBT.

programmes.name_en: West Bengal Swasthya Sathi (₹5 lakh cashless health cover)
programmes.funder: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
programmes.amount_note: Cashless health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year (basic) at empanelled hospitals, with a smart card issued in the name of a woman member; fully state-funded, no premium

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol at Duare Sarkar camps / notified enrolment centres
Smart card issued after biometric verification
Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals up to the annual limit

eligibility.income_note: Families in West Bengal not covered by other government health insurance; card issued in the name of the eldest woman of the family

programmes.source_snippet: Swasthya Sathi provides cashless health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year to West Bengal households.

programmes.name_en: Kerala social welfare pensions (old age, widow, disability and others)
programmes.funder: Local Self Government Department / Government of Kerala
programmes.amount_note: ₹1,600 per month (periodically revised) to eligible elderly, widows, persons with disabilities, agricultural workers, unmarried women above 50 and other listed categories

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the Grama Panchayat/municipality/corporation welfare section
Verification by the local body and sanction
Pension paid monthly to the bank account or delivered at home

eligibility.income_note: Destitute/low-income residents of Kerala in listed categories (old age, widow, disabled, agricultural labourer etc.); income ceilings set by LSGD

programmes.source_snippet: Kerala's welfare pension system pays ₹1,600 a month to elderly, widows, persons with disabilities and other eligible categories.

programmes.name_en: Kerala Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (state health assurance, integrated with PM-JAY)
programmes.funder: State Health Agency, Government of Kerala
programmes.amount_note: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover of ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year at empanelled hospitals, integrating PM-JAY in Kerala

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility with ration card at an Akshaya centre/hospital kiosk
KASP/Ayushman card issued after eKYC
Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

eligibility.income_note: Poor and vulnerable families in Kerala as per SECC/state criteria, integrated with the Ayushman Bharat beneficiary base

programmes.source_snippet: KASP gives Kerala's eligible families ₹5 lakh cashless annual health cover integrated with Ayushman Bharat.

programmes.name_en: Gujarat Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY scholarship)
programmes.funder: Department of Education, Government of Gujarat
programmes.amount_note: Tuition assistance (up to 50% of fees, capped by course: e.g., up to ₹2 lakh for professional courses, lower caps for diploma/general graduation) plus hostel and book/instrument assistance for eligible students
programmes.deadline_note: Applications open each year after board/admission results

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on mysy.guj.nic.in in the year of admission
Verification of merit percentile, income and institution
Assistance paid to institution/student by DBT

eligibility.income_note: Gujarat students with family income up to ₹6 lakh/year and required merit percentiles entering diploma, graduation or professional courses

programmes.source_snippet: MYSY funds tuition, hostel and book assistance for meritorious Gujarat students from families earning up to ₹6 lakh a year.

programmes.name_en: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (₹15,000 staged grant for girls)
programmes.funder: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
programmes.amount_note: Total ₹15,000 in six stages from birth to admission in graduation/diploma (₹2,000 at birth, ₹1,000 immunisation, ₹2,000 Class I, ₹2,000 Class VI, ₹3,000 Class IX, ₹5,000 higher education)

procedure_steps.detail: Register on mksy.up.gov.in within six months of the relevant stage
Upload documents; district verification
Stage-wise DBT to the guardian's/girl's bank account

eligibility.income_note: Girls born in UP resident families with annual income up to ₹3 lakh; maximum two girls per family (exceptions for twins/adoption)

programmes.source_snippet: Kanya Sumangala gives ₹15,000 in six stages for each eligible girl child in Uttar Pradesh from birth to higher education.
